subject: Your 3AM chart is ready
preview_text: The one feature that stops revenge trades when markets move fast. Open it now.
body_paragraphs: It’s 3AM. You see a pump on Binance, FOMO kicks in, and you’re about to buy the top again. We’ve all been there. Right now, while volatility is spiking, is the perfect time to use Predictify Coach—the calm AI mentor that talks you out of revenge trades.

Last night, our users saw Bitcoin flash crash 4% in an hour. The noise from Twitter influencers was deafening, but Predictify Coach didn’t flinch. It analyzed your journal, saw you lost 12% on similar moves, and whispered: Wait for the 1H confirmation. Those who listened saved an average of $340 in losses. That’s not luck—that’s data beating gut.

You already have this feature in your app. Just open Crypto AI, tap the Coach icon, and tell it what you’re feeling right now. It’s free to try for 7 days, and it works even if you’re on the free plan. No setups, no confusing charts—just a sharp, disciplined voice in your pocket.
Open the app now and ask Predictify Coach about your next trade. P.S. The AI just flagged a high-confidence setup on your watchlist—check it before the market opens.
